scale_cues: I used a large square white dinner plate about 25–27 cm across and the potato cubes, which look about 2–3 cm per side. No cutlery or hand is in the shot.
assumptions: The dark sliced meat is beef steak cooked to medium. It could also be lamb.
The pale meat at the top of the plate is roasted chicken breast. It could also be pork loin.
The pale green slices among the cauliflower are cooked leeks. They could also be onion.
I assumed cooking oil was used for the seared meat and the roasted potatoes. I did not see any separate sauce.
The chopped herbs and garlic weigh less than 5 g, so I counted them with the beef.
